ops.text: Termination for Convenience by Customer. For purposes of this Section 5.4, "Customer" means IBM. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to MSL, in which case MSL shall refund to Customer, on a pro rata basis, any fees prepaid by Customer for the period after the effective date of termination.

input.comment: [Playbook] We need an exit right: the three-year term currently lets IBM leave only for cause or by giving six months' notice against renewal. We have added a Customer termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, consistent with our preferred position; MSL's exit remains for cause or non-renewal only.
input.summary: Add Customer (IBM) termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
